_nota: One card per organ in the contract. Answers the challenge's 5 guiding questions. Illustrative content based on NASA HRP; written with AI assistance (Claude) and reviewed by the team.

corazon.como_medir: Pulse and blood pressure need different preparation. Open each indicator's guide for device, steps and mistakes. Log context and unit; with urgent symptoms, ask for help without waiting for another reading.
corazon.por_que: Pulse and blood pressure give information about the cardiovascular system; a single reading does not identify the cause of a change or establish a diagnosis.
corazon.efecto_espacio: Without gravity, blood shifts toward the chest and head; the heart and vessels adapt and blood pressure and pulse can change.
corazon.a_quien_avisar: Yellow: repeat the measurement. Red or chest pain: alert the crew immediately.
corazon.prevencion: Hydration according to the plan, daily exercise and good rest.

cerebro.como_medir: Log your hours of sleep and your mood and stress from 1 to 5 every day. The trend over several days is what matters.
cerebro.por_que: Sleep and mood affect attention, decisions and teamwork.
cerebro.efecto_espacio: Isolation, confinement and irregular schedules affect sleep and mood; on the Station people sleep about 6 hours.
cerebro.a_quien_avisar: Several days of little sleep or low mood: crew medical officer. Thoughts of self-harm: alert immediately.
cerebro.prevencion: A fixed sleep schedule, little screen light before sleeping, routines and contact with family when there is a signal.

pulmones.como_medir: Pulse oximeter on a clean, warm finger; stay still until the number stabilizes.
pulmones.por_que: It shows whether the body gets enough oxygen and warns about problems with the ship's air.
pulmones.efecto_espacio: Ship air is recycled: high CO₂ or low oxygen cause headaches and tiredness.
pulmones.a_quien_avisar: Several crew members with symptoms or shortness of breath: alert immediately.
pulmones.prevencion: Monitor the ship's air indicators and report symptoms early.

sangre.como_medir: Glucose meter from the kit; note whether it was fasting or after eating.
sangre.por_que: Glucose reflects available energy and metabolism.
sangre.efecto_espacio: Diet, stress and sleep change it; in the Inspiration4 crew each person varied differently from their own normal.
sangre.a_quien_avisar: Very low value with symptoms: onboard protocol and alert the crew.
sangre.prevencion: Regular meals according to the mission plan and repeat strange measurements.

huesos.como_medir: Density is measured before and after the mission; on board, log daily exercise and pain.
huesos.por_que: Weak bones increase the risk of fractures when returning to gravity or arriving on Mars.
huesos.efecto_espacio: Bone density drops 1 to 1.5 % per month; with resistance exercise, about 0.3 to 0.5 %.
huesos.a_quien_avisar: A blow with strong pain or deformity: immobilize and alert the crew.
huesos.prevencion: Resistance and cardiovascular exercise every day.

ojos.como_medir: The mission's periodic vision test; note any new blurry vision.
ojos.por_que: Good vision is key to reading instruments and procedures.
ojos.efecto_espacio: The shift of fluids toward the head can change the eye (SANS).
ojos.a_quien_avisar: New change: crew medical officer. Blurry vision with a strong headache: alert immediately.
ojos.prevencion: Take the scheduled vision tests and report changes early.

piel.como_medir: The kit's thermometer, always the same way; check the skin in good light.
piel.por_que: Temperature detects infections; the skin shows irritation or allergies.
piel.efecto_espacio: Skin rashes are the most common medical event on the Station (about 1.1 per flight year).
piel.a_quien_avisar: Fever or a growing rash: crew medical officer.
piel.prevencion: Clean, dry skin, no scratching and compare with previous days.

radiacion.como_medir: Check your personal dosimeter and the space weather alerts. The app uses real NASA DONKI solar events synced at the last connection.
radiacion.por_que: Flares and solar particle events can increase the radiation dose within a few hours.
radiacion.efecto_espacio: Outside Earth's protection radiation is higher; in 6 months on the Station a person receives 80 to 160 mSv, compared with 2–3.6 mSv per year on Earth.
radiacion.a_quien_avisar: Solar particle event: go to the shielded area and alert the crew. Recent strong flare: watch your dosimeter.
radiacion.prevencion: Know the route to the shielded area, check the dosimeter and sync space weather whenever there is a signal.
radiacion.fuente: NASA DONKI (CCMC / NASA GSFC) + NASA HRP – Space Radiation
